protocol.selection: Native intact-policy states at decisions 600/900/1200, first32environment slots, known goal only. Saved by separate behavior analysis.
protocol.state_timing: Saved h/c BEFORE this input, plus exact native embedding/current/goal input. Other goal variants are recomputed on CPU.
protocol.metrics: Expected noiseless one-step goal-disk progress in mm and target translation toward true center. Equal sampled-episode weights within each seed.
protocol.subsets: All; near (<0.6m from true center); far (>=0.6m).
protocol.statistics: Exploratory follow-up after scripted-replay analysis. Eight paired seed means. Holm within seven contrasts for each metric/subset; not across metrics/subsets.
protocol.current_extension: Current-only, both-input and current-reversal variants added after inspecting initial seed3 goal-only results, before other on-policy models. Additional metric is translation alignment with actual motion direction.
protocol.ray_extension: Exploratory diagnostic added after seeing two-action concentration in native snapshots3–8. Select dominant translation and turn identities from intact probabilities. Straight ray intersects true goal disk when forward projection>0 and absolute lateral distance<0.3m. Balanced agreement averages go-probability on ray hits and turn-probability on misses, each averaged within episode then over sampled episodes. This is not an optimal action/value oracle; it ignores inertia and future turning.
protocol.inertial_extension: Also label near states by whether23noiselessdecisions (1.533seconds) holdingdominanttranslation wouldhittruegoaldisk, retaininginitialvf/vs/vr andwallcollisions. Norespawn ornewpolicydecisions. Samebalancedgo/turn diagnostic, notoptimalcontrol. PGCseed5isathree-actionexception; exclusionofpairedseed5reportedassensitivity.
limitations: Native models visit different physical states; the native contrast is descriptive.
Goal-code interventions within each model hold its previous state and current experience fixed.
One-step utility undercounts useful turn actions and is not navigation performance.

action_strategy.basis: Action identities selected from native intact probabilities averaged across saved states; not selected from intervention outcomes.

near_inertial_capture.caveat: Dominant-go diagnostic, not an optimal-action oracle. PGC seed5 uses a meaningful third action, so its dominant-pair diagnostic ignores that alternative.
